rows.Kwic: 蘆葦蕭蕭江岸秋，長天獨月向西流。離鈎三寸無人道，笑倚蘭橈自點頭。

Override.AttributionNote: 禪林類聚 explicitly marks this verse 無盡居士云. Zhang Shangying, Layman Wujin, is the exact verse author: his boat verse says that three inches from the hook no one speaks, while the boatman smiles and nods against the oar.

rows.Kwic: 梁山觀禪師。僧問：如何是空劫已前事？師云：擊動乾坤鼓，時人聽不聞。

Override.AttributionNote: 禪林類聚, Liangshan Yuanguan case. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks what the matter before the empty aeon is, and Liangshan answers with the unheard drum. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.
